market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $50,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC's 2026 low so far is ~$60K (Feb). Currently ~$77K on Apr 28. To dip to $50K requires ~35% drop in 8 months — meaningfully below the existing 2026 low. Possible in a deep bear scenario but tail-risk only. Estimate ~15-20%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Fed policy shock or systemic crypto event could cause cascade lower.
